title: Admin-owned shared starting preset

request.text: thêm tính năng set as default, dể ai truy cập vào link cũng thấy được setting đã lưu

decision: Only the owner may publish shared defaults. Use private Blob storage, same-origin HttpOnly administrator sessions and native actions/public password input. Capture and apply the native settings codec; do not persist credentials in settings or alter the accepted beam.
result: Version 1.2.0 deployed to https://nodeanimation.vercel.app/. Administrator-only Set as default persists canonical settings in private Blob storage. Current Light/Dots preset seeded; new visits receive it. Credentials remain server/session owned.
checks: PASS: 3 focused unit checks and schema acceptance coverage
PASS: 2 production browser scenarios (9.2s), including fresh visitor/reload, admin/guest/failure and export secrecy
PASS: canonical product source boundary, no violations
PASS: final build, deployment alias and live API authentication/storage/public read
LIMITATION: protected feature wrapper timed out during plan loading; no protected feature pass claimed
PASS: online Shared Default panel visual inspection and screenshot
risks: Shared defaults apply on the next visit; already-open editing sessions keep their values.
